name: Danmaku native (弹幕原生)
rationale:
The design takes its look from the product itself: danmaku scrolling over a screen. It does this in three places and keeps the rest of the UI as a calm, rounded, professional settings app.

1) The bottom dock is a dark, video-player-style control bar in both themes, always visible on every page:
   - A round pink play/pause button.
   - State and round number.
   - A progress track that counts down to the next capture. It turns cyan and striped during the 5 s start delay.
   - Compact live stats.
   - 生成一次.
   - The bilibili-style 「弹」 toggle (overlay visible/hidden), and 清屏.
   "Is it running, and when is the next shot?" is the most frequent question. The answer is visible from anywhere, and the old six header buttons collapse into one familiar metaphor.

2) Live previews render real danmaku in the current style:
   - 弹幕外观 has a sticky preview with true 1:1 font size, palette, opacity, shadow and a zone guide, plus dark/light backdrops so readability can be checked. It also shows a zone minimap with lane counts computed by the overlay's own laneLayout, and how much of the screen width the longest comment takes.
   - 总览 shows the last round's actual comments flying in the configured style.
   - Logs show comments as dark "danmaku pills" in palette colors.

3) Sparse playful accents:
   - The brand mark is made of stacked comment lines.
   - Soft pink/cyan pill lines drift across the right side of the hero only (masked, and they respect reduced motion).
   - The rhythm timeline shows the three comments of a round as staggered pill "lanes".
   - The hero uses the character's own name, e.g. 「Mika 正在陪你看屏幕」 or 「Mika 准备好了」 during the start delay.

The long single page is split into 8 focused pages, grouped 实时 (总览, 生成日志) and 设置 (模型接口, 弹幕外观, 角色与称呼, 提示词模板, 运行节奏, 截图与历史). Every settings page uses the same two-pane split: a form column plus a right aside that explains or previews that page:
   - Connection test (模型接口).
   - Filled-in system prompt (角色与称呼).
   - Placeholder palette with current values (提示词模板).
   - Live request/cache meters with the 50% compaction mark (截图与历史).

Hard concepts get visuals instead of paragraphs:
   - The three history modes are radio cards with tiny window diagrams and 缓存友好 / 每轮失去缓存 chips.
   - The interval, start delay, generation and release window are drawn as a timeline.
   - Request size and history screenshots are meters with a tick at half the limit, because that is where a compaction shrinks to.

Save stays global in each page header (保存 Ctrl S vs 已保存). Unsaved pages get a pink dot in the nav, so dirty state never gets lost across pages.

Other checks:
   - Pink is never used for body text below AA. The filled accent is #d6336c with white text (4.6:1) in light mode, and #ff7aa5 with near-black text (7.4:1) in dark mode. Decorative pink #fb7299 and cyan #23ade5 are used only for shapes.
   - Every control is at least 32 px and has a visible label or an sr-only label.
   - The layout was verified at 1120x760 and 940x660 in light and dark with no horizontal scroll.
informationArchitecture:
SHELL (grid: sidebar | main, dock spans the full width at the bottom)
- Sidebar: 212 px wide (196 px below a 1060 px window).
  - Brand: mark + 弹幕伴侣 / Danmaku Companion.
  - Profile switcher button: small label 当前配置 + active profile name + chevrons. It opens a popover (role=menu):
    - Header row 「切换配置 · 切换前自动保存」.
    - Profile list (menuitemradio). Each row has a check on the active profile and updatedAt (MM-DD) on the right. Selecting one runs switchProfile, which saves the draft first.
    - 重命名当前配置: input prefilled with profileName + 重命名 button. Disabled when the name is empty or unchanged.
    - 复制为新配置: input (placeholder 基于当前配置) + 新建 → createProfile.
    - Danger item 删除“<name>”…: confirm, then deleteProfile. Disabled when there is only 1 profile.
  - Nav group 实时:
    - 总览 #overview
    - 生成日志 #logs, with a count badge.
  - Nav group 设置:
    - 模型接口 #model
    - 弹幕外观 #danmaku
    - 角色与称呼 #character
    - 提示词模板 #prompt
    - 运行节奏 #rhythm
    - 截图与历史 #capture
    - Each settings item shows a pink dot when its draft section is dirty.
  - Footer: lock icon 「配置与密钥只保存在本机」.
- Page header (every page): h1 + one-line description. On the right:
  - When dirty: 「● 有未保存的修改」 + primary 保存 (Ctrl S hint; label 保存中 while saving).
  - When clean: quiet disabled 「✓ 已保存」.
- Banners at the top of the active page body:
  - actionError: red, dismissible with ×.
  - status.lastError: red, not dismissible, with a 查看日志 link.
- Dock (72 px, dark in both themes), left to right:
  - Play/pause button: label 启动 or 暂停; 处理中 while workingAction==='start'.
  - State: 运行中 (pink pulsing dot), 已暂停 (amber), 空闲 (grey) or 错误 (red), with 「第 N 轮」 (status.cycles) underneath.
  - Countdown block:
    - Label 下次截图, or 首次截图 during the start delay.
    - Subtitle 「上次生成 HH:MM:SS · n 条」.
    - Right-aligned 「12 秒」.
    - Progress track: pink, or cyan-striped during the start delay. When idle it reads 「未启动 · 启动后 N 秒首次截图」.
  - Stats:
    - 耗时: providerLatencyMs.
    - 缓存命中 %: cached/prompt tokens.
    - 请求体: requestBytes / requestLimitBytes. Hidden below 1060 px.
    - The whole stats group is hidden below 980 px.
  - 生成一次 (sparkles; 生成中 while busy).
  - 「弹」 toggle (setOverlayVisible, aria-pressed).
  - 清屏 icon (clearOverlay).

PAGES
1. 总览 (#overview)
   - Hero card:
     - Countdown ring (from nextCycleAt), e.g. 12 s 后截图; 首次截图 in cyan during the start delay.
     - Live pill 「运行中 · 第 37 轮」.
     - Title 「<character.name> 正在陪你看屏幕」. Variants: 准备好了 during the delay, 在休息 when paused/idle, 遇到了问题 on error.
     - Sentence built from interval min–max, itemsPerCycle and release window min–max.
     - Chips: model id, format + max edge, 历史 N 轮 · mode label.
   - Four stat tiles:
     - 生成耗时: providerLatencyMs, a sparkline of the last 10 logs' durationMs (failed rounds in red), sub 预填充 from the last log's promptMs.
     - 缓存命中: % meter and 「cached / prompt tokens」.
     - 请求体: 3.1 / 48 MB meter with a tick at 50%; sub 「有效上限 48 MB」, or 「…（服务器 413 后学到）」 when requestLimitBytes is below the configured limit.
     - 历史截图: historyImages / historyMaxImages meter with a 50% tick.
   - 最近一轮弹幕: stage that renders the last successful log's comments in the current danmaku style, with header 「time · n/m 条 · 自动/手动」 and a 查看日志 → link.
   - 上下文摘要 card: contextSummary text clamped to 4 lines, contextSummaryAt + length. Chip 已启用, 生成中 (summarizing) or 未开启 (with a link to 截图与历史).
2. 生成日志 (#logs)
   - Toolbar:
     - Segmented filter 全部 / 失败 / 摘要, with counts (client-side).
     - 「最多保留 N 条」 (generationLogLimit).
     - 刷新 (spinner while loading).
     - 清空日志: danger, asks for confirmation, disabled when there are no logs.
   - Row (native details/summary), grid columns:
     - Status pill: 成功 green / 失败 red / 中断 amber / 摘要 violet.
     - completedAt time with the date underneath.
     - Reason: 自动 / 手动 (cyan) / 后台 (summary).
     - Preview: 「“first comment” 等 n 条」, or the red error text with an icon, or the summary text.
     - Tag chips: 缓存 x%, 输出截断 (finishReason=length), 压缩 −n 张 / 413 后压缩 (compaction), 312 字 (summary).
     - generated/requested 条 over the screen label (960×540 / 无截图 / 截图失败).
     - Duration.
     - Chevron.
   - Expanded detail:
     - Comments as danmaku pills in palette colors, or 「没有生成弹幕」.
     - Red banner for log.error and log.screen.error.
     - Amber callout when the output was truncated: 「输出 260 tokens，达到最大输出被截断…」.
     - Three meta groups:
       - 请求: 模型, 请求体 x / limit, 历史 rounds · Chinese mode label, 历史截图 保留 · 本次 n 张 / 不保留, 历史压缩 (compactionLabel incl. historyRecovery), 投放窗口.
       - Tokens 与耗时: 缓存/输入 (%), 输出 tokens + 截断 note, 预填充, 总耗时, 开始时间.
       - 截图: 来源, 尺寸, 格式 · q, 图片大小, 传输大小 + 已缩小以适应上限.
     - Collapsible 原始输出 (mono, max-height 180 px, scrolls).
   - Footer button 「显示更早的 N 条」 (page size 100).
3. 模型接口 (#model), split layout
   - Card 连接:
     - 接口地址 (Base URL): mono input with a link icon prefix.
     - API Key: password input with key prefix and an eye show/hide button; hint 本地服务通常可留空.
   - Card 模型与参数:
     - 模型: select of listModels results showing 「id · name · state · 视觉」, plus a refresh icon button. Chips for the selected model's state/视觉. Note 「从接口读到 n 个模型…」, or the error message in red. Falls back to a free text input when the list is empty.
     - 温度: slider 0–2 step 0.1 + number.
     - Switch 发送温度参数 (with explanation).
     - 最大输出 (tokens).
     - 超时 (shown in 秒, stored in ms).
   - Card 视觉输入: switch 发送截图, explaining that capture settings stop applying when it is off.
   - Aside:
     - 连接测试 card: full-width 测试连接 button (spinner while testing), result banner ok/bad with message + endpoint in mono, note 「测试前会先保存当前修改，并刷新模型列表」.
     - Tip callout about 生成一次.
4. 弹幕外观 (#danmaku), wide aside
   - Card 文字:
     - 字号: slider 10–96 + px.
     - 不透明度: slider shown as 20–100% (stored 0.2–1).
     - 单条最多字数 (字).
     - Switch 文字阴影.
   - Card 运动与分布:
     - 显示区域: segmented 全屏/上部/中部/下部 with mini band icons.
     - 滚动时长: slider 2–60 秒, hint 「穿过整个屏幕的秒数，越大越慢」.
     - 密度: slider 0.1–1.
   - Card 配色:
     - Mono comma list input (kept as typed while focused).
     - Swatch chips with hex.
     - Help: invalid colors are not saved.
   - Card 弹幕层与录屏: switch 截图时排除弹幕层 + amber callout 「开启后 OBS 等录屏、直播软件也录不到弹幕；需要 Windows 10 2004 及以上」.
   - Sticky aside 实时预览:
     - Dark/light backdrop segmented control (moon/sun).
     - Stage with dashed zone band guides.
     - Zone minimap + 「全屏 · 29 条轨道 / 平时使用其中 17 条 / 约 10 秒穿过屏幕」.
     - Meter 「最长一条（50 字）约占屏宽 57%」.
     - Note about the 1:1 size and the 1920×1080 estimate.
5. 角色与称呼 (#character)
   - Persona card: initial avatar, name, persona snippet · language.
   - Card 角色: 角色名, 语言 (datalist: zh-CN/zh-TW/ja/en), 人设 (textarea), 语气.
   - Card 你: 用户称呼, 用户身份.
   - Aside: 系统提示词预览, the template rendered with current values highlighted in pink; unresolvable tokens like {{jsonShape}} shown as grey tokens; 编辑模板 → link.
6. 提示词模板 (#prompt)
   - Card with tabs 系统提示词 / 用户提示词 (chip 空 when empty) / 摘要提示词 (summaryTemplate).
   - Full-height mono textarea.
   - Footer: char/line count + 查看填充后的效果 → link.
   - Aside 插入占位符: each row is a button showing code + meaning + current value, and inserts at the cursor. The full list:
     - companion.name / persona / tone / language
     - user.name / role
     - requestedCount
     - jsonShape
     - activeApp: dashed border, struck-through code, 未实现 tag, tooltip 「尚未实现：目前总是填入 unknown」.
     - On the 摘要 tab, also {{summaryMaxChars}}.
7. 运行节奏 (#rhythm)
   - Timeline card 「一轮是怎样进行的」: 启动 → cyan striped 启动延迟 5 秒 → 截图 → 生成 约 2.4 秒 (average latency) → 返回 → dashed 等待 14–28 秒, with a pink release-window band overlaid on its first part and 3 sample pills in two lanes → 下一轮.
   - 2×2 cards:
     - 截图间隔: min–max pair in 秒, 5–1800.
     - 启动延迟: 秒, 0–60.
     - 每轮弹幕: stepper, 1–12.
     - 投放窗口: min–max pair in 秒, 0–60.
8. 截图与历史 (#capture)
   - Card 截图:
     - 截图最长边 (px, 480–2160).
     - 格式: segmented JPEG/PNG.
     - JPEG 质量: slider 0.5–0.95, disabled when PNG.
     - Amber PNG callout when PNG + historyIncludeImages.
     - Row 录屏权限 with a 仅 macOS tag and an 打开系统设置 button; rendered only when isMac.
   - Card 历史与缓存:
     - 历史轮数 (轮).
     - 历史模式: three radio cards:
       - 满额重置
       - 分批滑动 with a green 缓存友好 chip
       - 逐轮滑动 with an amber 每轮失去缓存 chip
       - Each card has a one-line explanation and a small kept/dropped/new block diagram.
     - Switch 保留历史截图.
     - Inset block: 历史截图上限 (张, 0–50), 请求体上限 (MB, 1–512) and a cyan explainer callout (half-limit compaction, one re-prefill, 413 retry, upload cost).
     - Switch 上下文摘要 + 摘要上限 (字, 100–2000).
   - Card 隐私与存储:
     - 隐私黑名单: disabled input + 未实现 tag + hint text.
     - 保存截图到磁盘: disabled switch + 未实现.
     - 日志保留 (条, 10–2000).
   - Aside 实时用量:
     - Request meter with a 50% tick and 「有效上限 / 超限后压到 X MB」.
     - History screenshots meter with 「本轮发送 n 张 / 超限后保留 n 张」.
     - Cache meter + tokens.
     - 最近一次压缩 from the newest log with compaction (time · reason · dropped).
     - 在生成日志中查看 → link.

Mockup hashes and query switches:
- Pages: #overview #logs #model #danmaku #character #prompt #rhythm #capture.
- ?menu=profiles opens the profile popover.
- ?state=delay|paused|idle|error switches the dock/hero state.
- ?png=1 selects PNG on the capture page.
- ?open=N expands log row N.
- ?bg=light switches the preview backdrop.
- ?dirty=1|0 forces the save state.
- ?full=1 lets a full-page screenshot include the scrolled content.

components:
AppShell
- CSS grid with columns [sidebar | main] and rows [1fr | 72px dock].
- Height 100vh; only .page-body scrolls (scrollbar-gutter: stable).

BrandMark
- 34 px pink rounded square with three white comment bars and one cyan bar.
- Static.

ProfileSwitcher
- Button, 50 px.
- States:
  - hover: border --line-hover.
  - focus-visible: ring.
  - aria-expanded.
  - disabled while saving or a profile action is running.
- Popover: absolute, 272 px, shadow-2, role=menu.
  - Esc closes and returns focus to the button. Arrow keys move between items. A click outside closes it.
  - Profile rows are menuitemradio, 36 px high, hover --surface-3, check icon on the active one.
  - Rename and Duplicate are inline input + small button rows.
  - The 重命名 button is disabled when the name is unchanged or empty.
  - The delete row is red, disabled with 1 profile, and asks for confirmation.
  - Busy state: spinner replaces the icon on the clicked button.

NavItem
- Height 38, icon + label, optional count badge or dirty dot.
- hover: --surface-3.
- Current (aria-current=page): --accent-soft background, --accent-text, a 3 px accent bar at the left edge, badge background --accent-soft-2.
- Focus-visible outline.

PageHeader + SaveButton
- Dirty: primary pink button with save icon, label 保存 and a 「Ctrl S」 kbd chip, plus a 「● 有未保存的修改」 text on its left.
- Saving: spinner + 保存中, disabled.
- Clean: transparent, line border, text-3, check icon, 已保存, disabled (opacity kept at 1 for legibility).

Dock
- PlayButton: 46 px circle, --pink background, dark glyph. hover scale 1.04. Focus: white outline offset 3. Disabled + spinner while working. Label and aria-label switch between 启动 and 暂停.
- StateLabel: dot + text. The dot pulses only while running; colors pink / amber / grey / red.
- CountdownTrack:
  - role=progressbar, aria-valuetext 「12 秒后截图」.
  - Fill is a pink gradient with a white thumb.
  - Variant .delay: cyan stripes.
  - Variant .empty: no fill or thumb (paused/idle/error), countdown shows —.
- DockStat: label 11.5 px over a value 14 px/650, separated by 1 px rules.
- DockButton: 36 px, dark-2 background; hover dark-3; white focus ring. 生成一次 shows 生成中 + spinner while busy.
- OverlayToggle 「弹」:
  - 40×36, glyph 弹 inside a rounded outline.
  - aria-pressed=true: pink tint background with a pink border.
  - aria-pressed=false: grey with a diagonal slash.
  - title and aria-label say what a click will do (隐藏/显示弹幕层).
- 清屏 icon button: aria-label 「清空屏幕上的弹幕」.

Banner
- Variants:
  - bad: --bad-soft background, red icon, text in --text, optional link, optional 32 px × close button.
  - ok: used for the connection test.
- role=alert for errors.

Card
- 16 px radius, 1 px line, shadow-1.
- CardHead: 28 px TileIcon (pink/cyan/violet/ok/warn tints) + h2 15/650 + optional .sub + .tail actions.
- CardBody: grid gap 16.
- CardFoot: top border.

Field system
- Label: 13/600 with an optional right-aligned .hint (range or unit).
- .help: 12.5 text-3 below the control.
- TextInput: 36 px.
  - hover: border --line-hover.
  - focus: accent border + 3 px ring.
  - disabled: dashed border, surface-2 background, text-3, cursor not-allowed.
  - error (for invalid draft values): border --bad + help text in --bad.
  - Affix: unit suffix inside (px/秒/MB/张/轮/条/字/tokens/%), prefix icon, or an in-field 32 px icon button (eye toggle).
- NumberField: keeps the existing "typed text while editing, commit clamped value" behaviour. Add a `scale` prop for %↔0–1 and s↔ms.
- SliderField: range input (32 px hit area, 6 px track filled to --p, 18 px thumb with accent border, focus glow) + 96 px NumberField. Both bind to the same value. Disabled at 45% opacity.
- RangePair: two affix inputs with an en-dash. Validate min ≤ max; on blur, swap or clamp and show help in --bad.
- Stepper: 36 px − [value] +, buttons disabled at the range ends.
- SwitchRow: whole label clickable, ≥40 px. Title 13.5/600 + description 12.5 text-3. Switch 40×22, accent when on. Disabled state dims the switch and the title; a TodoTag can sit next to the title.
- Segmented: radio inputs inside labels.
  - Selected: surface background + inset line + shadow.
  - focus-visible: outline on the label.
  - .full makes the options stretch.
  - Zone variant adds a mini band icon per option.
- ModeRadioCard: radio card.
  - Checked: accent border + accent-soft background + filled dot.
  - Focus outline.
  - Contains title + status chip, a description, and a block diagram (kept grey / dropped dashed / new pink).
- Chip: 24 px pill in neutral/pink/cyan/ok/warn/bad/violet.
- TodoTag 「未实现」: dashed outline, text-3, carries a title tooltip with the hint text.
- Mac tag 「仅 macOS」: neutral.
- Callout: neutral/warn/cyan, with icon + text.

Meter
- 8 px track, colored fill, optional .mark tick at 50% (the compaction target).
- Fill has min-width 6 px so tiny values stay visible.

CountdownRing
- SVG r=46, stroke 9, track --surface-3.
- Arc is pink (cyan during the start delay) and represents the remaining time.
- Hidden when nothing is scheduled.

StatTile
- Key row (icon tile + label), big value with a small unit, meter or sparkline, sub line (ellipsis).

Sparkline
- 10 bars from recent logs; failed rounds drawn in --bad.

DanmakuStage
- Rounded box with an illustrated backdrop (dark night-game scene / light document scene) and optional dashed zone band.
- .dm lines use exactly the overlay text style:
  - weight 800, line-height 1.25.
  - color from the palette.
  - opacity from config.
  - the overlay's text-shadow when shadow is on.
- Animated linearly across the stage over speedSeconds.
- Optional caption chip.

ZoneMinimap
- 112×63 screen thumbnail with the highlighted zone band and lane stripes.

SwatchList
- 32 px pill per color: color dot + hex in mono.

LogRow
- details/summary.
  - hover: surface-2.
  - focus-visible: inset outline.
  - open: accent-tinted border + 3 px soft ring.
- Chevron rotates 90° when open.
- Detail is rendered lazily, only while open (keeps the existing memo).
- DanmakuPill: 32 px dark pill with colored text and a colored dot. Dark background in both themes so light colors like #f8fafc stay readable.
- MetaGroup: titled definition list (dt text-3, dd right-aligned 550 weight).
- RawOutput: nested details, mono pre, max-height 180, scrolls.

Tabs
- 44 px tabs. Selected: accent text + 2.5 px underline.
- role=tablist/tab, arrow-key navigation.

PlaceholderButton
- 44 px row: mono code (accent) + meaning · current value; a plus icon appears on hover/focus.
- Todo variant: dashed border, struck-through code, TodoTag.

PromptPreview
- Mono pre; substituted values highlighted with accent-soft-2; unknown tokens shown on a grey chip.

Timeline
- Nodes are 30 px circles (play/camera/sparkles).
- Segments: striped (delay), solid (generation), dashed (wait), plus an overlaid pink release band with comment pills in two lanes.
- Labels under each segment.
- The whole thing is role=img with a full aria-label sentence.

EmptyState
- Dashed rounded box with a muted icon and text, e.g. 还没有生成记录.
- Can reuse two drifting pill lines as decoration.
overlayStyleIdeas:
- Keep the overlay and the settings preview pixel-identical. Move the .danmaku-line typography (weight 800, line-height 1.25, text-shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.26)) into one shared CSS file that both renderers import, and drive font size, opacity and color with the same custom properties (--danmaku-font-size, --danmaku-opacity, color).
- Offer a bilibili-style outline as an alternative to the soft shadow: paint-order: stroke fill; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.12em rgba(10,12,20,.6). Classic danmaku use a 1–2 px dark stroke. It reads better on very bright screens (documents, white web pages) than a blur shadow. The 文字阴影 switch could later become a 3-way 描边 / 阴影 / 无.
- Mark the companion's voice subtly. Add an optional tiny leading marker: a 0.35em pink dot, or the character's initial in a small rounded chip. Viewers can then tell AI comments from real on-screen text, and comments with source:'system' get a cyan marker.
- Fade in each comment over its first 150 ms (opacity 0→value) so batch entries feel less abrupt. Keep the linear scroll; do not add easing, since bullet comments must keep a constant speed for lane math.
- Readability guard: when the palette contains near-white (#f8fafc) and shadow/outline is off, force a faint outline. Very light colors are invisible on white apps.
- Font stack for the overlay: "Microsoft YaHei UI", "PingFang SC", "Segoe UI", "Segoe UI Emoji", sans-serif, so emoji in comments render in color on Windows.
- Optional for later: bilibili's fixed top/bottom comment modes (顶部/底部弹幕) for highlight lines (e.g. the first comment of a round), centered and shown for 4 s. These need a new config field, so treat them as a future idea, not part of this redesign.
- The preview stage in settings shows exactly these choices so users can judge them against light and dark content before saving.
implementationNotes:
STRUCTURE
- Split SettingsApp.tsx into:
  - Shell: Sidebar, PageHeader, Dock, Banners.
  - Eight page components: OverviewPage, LogsPage, ModelPage, DanmakuPage, CharacterPage, PromptPage, RhythmPage, CapturePage.
- Keep all state where it is now: config, draft, dirty, status, profiles, logs, modelList, connection, workingAction, overlayVisible, the editSection/save/switch logic. Pass it to the pages via props, or a small SettingsContext. No router library: page = useState synced to location.hash (hashchange listener), default 'overview'.
- Per-page dirty dots: compare config vs draft per section with the existing isDraftDirty helper or a section-level variant. The runtime section is split between two pages:
  - rhythm = intervalMin/Max, startDelay, itemsPerCycle, releaseWindowMin/Max
  - capture = everything else in runtime, plus nothing from danmaku
  - danmaku = the whole danmaku section, including excludeOverlayFromCapture
  - character = character + user
  - prompt = prompt
- Add a global Ctrl/Cmd+S keydown handler that calls saveDraft.

CSS
- Plain CSS with custom properties. Tokens on :root; dark overrides inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).
- In Electron, leave nativeTheme.themeSource = 'system' so prefers-color-scheme follows Windows.
- Set the BrowserWindow backgroundColor to the theme bg (#f4f5f9 / #121318) to avoid a white flash.
- The dock colors are theme-independent tokens.
- Uses :has() for segmented controls and mode cards (Chromium 105+, fine in Electron).
- The aside is position: sticky; top: 0 inside the scrolling .page-body.
- Breakpoints:
  - max-width 1060: sidebar 196, hide the 3rd dock stat, hide log tag chips, log meta groups in 2 columns with the last one spanning and showing 2 pairs per row.
  - max-width 980: hide dock stats, aside fixed at 264/284.
- Verified with no horizontal overflow at 940×660.
- The mockup CSS (style.css in the folder) is close to production-ready and can be copied, minus the mockup helpers .dirty-only/.clean-only and html.full.

COUNTDOWN AND START DELAY
- Tick a 1 s interval only while status.nextCycleAt exists. Show the countdown whenever nextCycleAt is set, regardless of state.
- For the progress fraction, record armedAt = Date.now() whenever nextCycleAt changes; progress = (now − armedAt) / (due − armedAt).
- RuntimeStatus does not say whether the timer is the start delay. Recommended: add a tiny field such as nextCycleKind: 'start-delay' | 'interval' (the controller already knows firstAfterStart). Interim fallback: treat it as the delay when cycles hasn't changed since start() resolved.
- Do not announce every second to screen readers. Use aria-live=polite only on the state label.

PREVIEW
- Import laneLayout / ZONE_BANDS / resolveOverlayStyle from renderer/overlay/lanes.ts.
- Lane count and preferred lanes come from laneLayout(style, 1080). Better: let main send the primary display size so the numbers match the user's screen.
- Width share = canvas-measured width of maxCommentLength CJK chars at fontSize / 1920 (or the display width), using the same createTextMeasurer as the overlay.
- Stage lines:
  - Animate `left: 100% → 0` combined with `transform: translateX(0 → -100%)`, or translate by a container-width CSS variable.
  - Duration = speedSeconds, so crossing time matches the real screen.
  - Re-key the lines when the palette or font size changes so they restart.
- The sample comments are static strings. On Overview, use the newest success log's comments.
- Backdrop scenes are inline SVG <symbol>s.

UNITS
- Opacity is shown as % and stored as 0.2–1.
- Timeout is shown in seconds and stored in ms.
- Extend NumberField with scale/integer handling so clamping still happens in stored units via LIMITS.

LOGS
- Keep memo(GenerationLogItem) and render the detail only while open.
- Map historyMode to Chinese labels: reset-on-limit 满额重置, batch-sliding 分批滑动, sliding 逐轮滑动. The current UI prints the raw value.
- reason 'summary' renders a violet 摘要 pill and the summary text instead of comments.
- Row tags:
  - finishReason === 'length' → 输出截断
  - compaction → 压缩 −n 张, or 413 后… using compactionTriggerLabels
  - cache % when promptTokens is known
- Filtering is client-side over the loaded array.
- 清空日志 must confirm (window.confirm is fine, matching profile delete).
- Comment pills take a color from the current palette by index; logs don't store colors.

PROMPT PAGE
- Insert placeholder: use textarea.setRangeText(token, selStart, selEnd, 'end') on a ref, then dispatch editSection('prompt', {…}) with the new value, then refocus.
- The 摘要提示词 tab edits prompt.summaryTemplate and adds a {{summaryMaxChars}} chip.
- The character-page preview should reuse renderTemplate if it can move into shared/ (messageBuilder lives in main). Otherwise do a simple {{key}} replace for preview only. Keep {{jsonShape}} unresolved as a grey token.

MODEL PAGE
- The connection result moves out of the global banner area into the 连接测试 aside card. Keep it in state and clear it on profile switch, as now.
- The model select falls back to a text input when the list is empty, as now.
- The refresh button shows a spinner while modelListLoading.

ICONS (lucide-react)
- Pause, Play, Sparkles, Eraser (清屏), Save, Check, Layers, ChevronsUpDown, LayoutDashboard, ScrollText, Cpu, Palette, UserRound, Braces, Timer, Camera, Link, KeyRound, Eye/EyeOff, RefreshCw, Cable, CircleCheck, CircleAlert, TriangleAlert, Info, Lightbulb, Type, SlidersHorizontal, MessagesSquare, Gauge, Database, Upload, Image, History, Shield, Lock, Activity, Shrink, Scissors, Moon, Sun, Plus, Minus, Pencil, CopyPlus, Trash2, ArrowRight, ChevronRight, LoaderCircle.
- The 「弹」 toggle is a text glyph, not an icon.

ACCESSIBILITY
- Every input has a <label> (sr-only for paired min/max fields).
- Segmented controls are radiogroups with aria-labelledby.
- The overlay toggle uses aria-pressed.
- Nav uses aria-current.
- Popover: role=menu with focus management.
- Tabs follow the WAI-ARIA pattern.
- Focus-visible outlines everywhere.
- Hit targets ≥32 px (most are 36–44).
- Contrast checked: text-3 ≥4.5 on all surfaces, accent text 5.8:1, white on accent 4.6:1, dark on dark-mode accent 7.4:1, chips ≥4.5.
- prefers-reduced-motion stops the pulse, the drift and the preview scrolling.

EDGE CASES
- Long profile and character names truncate with an ellipsis.
- The hero sentence comes from config. With itemsPerCycle=1 or releaseWindow 0, adjust the wording (「立即飘出」).
- When status.requestLimitBytes is below the configured MB, label it 「服务器 413 后学到」.
- historySummaryEnabled=false: the Overview summary card shows an empty state linking to #capture.
- The macOS permission row renders only when isMac.

FILES IN THE FOLDER
- mockup.html: built, self-contained.
- src.html, style.css, icons.svgfrag: sources. icons.cjs extracts lucide paths; build.cjs inlines them.
- shots*.sh: screenshot commands.
weaknesses:
- Eight pages instead of one scroll: related settings are one click apart. For example, 保留历史截图 is on 截图与历史 while 发送截图 is on 模型接口. Users who liked seeing everything at once lose that, and there is no settings search.
- The dark dock is always present and heavy in light mode. It also costs 72 px of vertical space at the 660 px minimum height, leaving about 520 px for content on dense pages like 截图与历史 (more scrolling).
- Some of the new data is not in RuntimeStatus today, so it needs a small backend addition or a heuristic:
  - Telling the start delay apart from a normal wait.
  - The progress fraction of the countdown.
  - The real display size for the lane and width estimates.
- The preview is an approximation. Crossing time is scaled to the preview width, lane counts assume 1920×1080, and the sample texts are invented. It can disagree slightly with what the overlay does on the user's monitor.
- The pink accent and the red error color are fairly close on the hue wheel. The design mitigates this with alert icons, tinted backgrounds and wording, but color-blind users rely on those cues.
- Several pieces are new client-side code compared with today:
  - Latency sparkline, log filters, row tags.
  - Per-page dirty dots, placeholder insertion at the cursor, prompt preview rendering.
  - Width-share estimate, timeline drawing.
  More surface area to build and test.
- The playful copy (「Mika 正在陪你看屏幕」, 「准备好了」) depends on the character name and on Chinese grammar. Very long names, or English persona names, need truncation and may read oddly.
- The rhythm timeline is illustrative, not to scale. Extreme settings (e.g. a 1–1800 s interval) cannot be drawn proportionally.
- The Overview 上下文摘要 card is empty by default (the feature defaults to off). A first-run user sees a dead card unless it is swapped for a setup checklist.
- The screenshots were rendered with WenQuanYi Zen Hei and synthetic bold. On Windows, Microsoft YaHei UI / Segoe UI Variable have different metrics, so a few tight spots need a check in the real app: the dock stats at 1060–1120 px and the log row columns.
- The design relies on CSS :has() and sticky positioning inside scroll containers. Both are fine in Electron's Chromium, but they would need fallbacks if this ever shipped as a web page.
